localRegressionEvidence: Source head and work commit atomically. Legacy heads backfill on capture. Returning to the same bytes or replacing the source grant requires a new index incarnation.
The final code also fences the owner authority generation, retains full resolution for standalone images and requires complete independent review and embedding receipts on searchable rows.
Held image has zero document embeddings. A later independently approved image is searchable and can be reopened. Query admission and result acknowledgement loss do not repeat paid attempts.
Across 96 units, the highest scoring hit in the last batch ranks first with one query embedding. A 520-unit fixture verifies continuation beyond a single scan.
Targeted tests covered the source worker, private model session, index, search, prompt assembly and original card guards. Server TypeScript compilation passed.
priorFailure: The first local provider fixture omitted finishReason. The gateway rejected it, persisted unknown and stopped. Correcting the fixture yielded a passing emulator run before the one real provider trial.
limits: The live trial ran on the implementation working tree. Subsequent authority fencing, standalone-image handling, cross-batch ranking and review activity labeling were checked locally. No second paid trial, real personal API key, production deployment or finished chat UI was claimed.
